experience.summary: Built a web attendance system with real-time camera capture and GPS radius validation for internal staff. Ran the company website end to end: administration, database migrations, content updates, and e-commerce improvements. Designed calendars, product flyers, brochures, and displays for lab equipment.
Custom visual assets, catalogs, banners, and promotional flyers tailored to each client's brand guidelines.
Handled warehouse logistics for imported lab equipment, kept the company website's product data clean with daily CRUD updates, and administered its Tokopedia and E-Katalog storefronts.
Verified and batch-entered student data in Excel, and supported the IT team with design revisions and departmental website updates.
